title: Warm Crisp Spanish Shrimp Fideua
description: A cultured and cozy Spanish dish featuring succulent shrimp, crispy fideua, and a hint of yeast, all combined in a delicious and high-protein-friendly meal.
instructions: Preheat the robata-grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the fideua according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and fully cooked.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked fideua to the skillet with the shrimp and stir to combine.
Pour the lemon juice mixture over the top of the fideua and shrimp.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated robata-grill and cook for 2-3 minutes, until the fideua is crispy and golden brown.
Remove the skillet from the grill and sprinkle the yeast over the top of the fideua.
Serve the Warm Crisp Spanish Shrimp Fideua hot, garnished with fresh parsley and lemon wedges.
